Welcome to Company

Established in the year 2003, we, Libo Interior Solutions Private Limited, are an eminent Service Provider, Trader, Wholesaler, and importer of False Flooring, False Ceiling, Mineral Fiber Ceiling, Partition System and much more. Ours is a Private Limited firm, which is based in Mumbai, (Maharashtra, India). The services that we offer are highly reliable, efficient and cost-effective. Our services are of premium quality and are timely delivered to the clients. The team of professionals plays a significant role in the success of our firm. Our clients can avail these services by varied payment modes such as Cash, Cheque, Credit Card and DD. Moreover, we acknowledge variegated payment terms like D/A and L/C. The services that we offer find extensive application in office areas, retails, health-care spaces, public areas and educational institutes

Mission

Our mission is to create reward experience and value that combine functionality with high quality and innovation for our customers. We want every partner and client experience to be the talk of a life time. Also, to define the most sophisticated and superior standard of quality in every false ceiling.

Vision

Our vision is to be a reputable, sustainable, and desirable premier ceiling firm, innovative designs and superior quality finishing. Our main vision is to consistently deliver exclusive design services that bring a complete satisfaction of our partners and clients requirements. This vision has been the core of our history and cultural value of design which is still the master key for our prospects.

Client Satisfication

To be a company that offers superior quality products and services to people. We want to be the best in terms of product value, customer satisfaction, employee talent with consistent and predictable growth.
